exercizer.assistant.step1.content: The application has been improved for smoother navigation and better display on mobile.
exercizer.assistant.step1.content.1d: Create and distribute subjects to submit or interactive activities, manage reminders, corrections and access answer statistics.
exercizer.assistant.step1.title: Your Exercises app gets a new look!
exercizer.assistant.student.step2.conten:
Subjects to submit have been improved:
  • Ability to upload corrections in an undistributed subject and thus share it in the Library
  • Ability to load multiple corrections for a subject directly from the Document space.
  • Ability to upload multiple files in student responses.
exercizer.assistant.student.step2.title: Improvement of subjects to submit
exercizer.assistant.teacher.step2.conten: The "Fill-in zone" question type has been improved and simplified in creation mode and response mode, particularly on mobile (smartphones and tablets).
Multiple choice, ordering, fill-in-the-blank, fill-in zones... Mix different question types to create fun and stimulating exercises.
exercizer.assistant.teacher.step2.title: Fill-in zones thoroughly revised
exercizer.assistant.teacher.step3.conten: The assignment type "Subjects to submit" has also been improved. Teachers can retrieve corrections from their document space and upload up to 5 corrections per assignment. Additionally, students can also upload multiple response files.
The assignment type "Subjects to submit" allows you to collect student work in file form (images, audio or even office documents), monitor submissions, and send reminders if needed.
exercizer.assistant.teacher.step3.title: Improvement of subjects to submit
exercizer.assistant.teacher.step4.conten: Would you like to link to a distributed exercise from a message or other content? This is now possible directly from the text editor.
Would you like to link to a distributed exercise from the Homework notebook, a Blog or a Course? Distribute your exercises from other applications by creating an internal link in the text editor.
exercizer.assistant.teacher.step4.title: Integrate your exercises into your educational content
Integrate your exercises into your educational content
